W6 after E053. Time ≈ 0.1 s fixed + steps × per-step cost. Per-step cost is pixel-proportional compute plus a bandwidth-bound part (BN/GELU/pointwise, ~27% of a 32 px step). Tip E049: 5.198 s, 0.7535 on seeds 0–2. E052 (selection + top-up) read 4.987 s and 0.7555. E053 (group-2 freeze from 85%) read 5.075 s and 0.7562. So the group-2 freeze dose is not a cliff, unlike group 1 in E037.

Mechanisms and support:
1. Accuracy rises slowly with optimizer steps, about 1.5–2.5 s/pp. Step, epoch and sample cuts trade near the dial (E020, E031, E040, E041, E045, E048).
2. Early low resolution is nearly free (E026, E033). The 32 px tail carries accuracy (E011, E018, E024).
3. Late backward truncation saves more than its MAC share, because frozen blocks also skip BN/GELU backward, optimizer updates and Lookahead traffic (E028, E036, E046, E049, E053). Group 2 tolerates earlier freezing: E053 saved about 0.12 s with no measurable loss. Group 1 freezing early is costly (E037). The stem needs some 32 px exposure, so I expect intermittent stem backward to cost something, but the loss is not known.
4. Averaging, LS, warm-up, Lookahead-interval, BN-recalibration and batch-split tweaks are null or negative. The recipe is near a local optimum.
5. Math-identical systems work is worth 1–2% each. About 2.5% of GPU time is outside the step graphs.
6. wd ×0.5 helped about 0.2 pp (E016).
7. Architecture surgery on high-resolution work (E051) loses accuracy faster than it saves time.
8. ReLU might save 1–3% of time, with an accuracy cost of about -0.1 to -0.3 pp.
9. Build-to-build kernel reselection moves 3-seed accuracy by ±0.3 pp. Time noise is ±0.04 s. The population mean is about 0.752–0.754, so the bar is barely cleared.

Misses: E046, E048, E052 and E053 all came in faster than my centers, and E053 accuracy beat my range. Stacked trims and freezes yield more than I forecast. Accuracy has a wide band, so I keep ranges about ±0.35 pp wide.

Unsure: the true tip mean, selection bias, PCIe transfer, whether group-2 freezing can extend further (the dose curve looks flat), and whether intermittent stem backward is neutral.

forecasts.reason: Saves about 35 half-phase stem backward steps (~0.1 s); accuracy cost is likely small but within noise.
Saves ~4% of the frozen steps (~0.06 s); the cliff is likely a dose effect, so a small loss, hard to resolve at this noise.
Likely projected saving under 3%, so the offline step closes with no run; time and accuracy stay near the tip.
Stacked cuts plus a top-up probably land about 4% below E049 at near-equal accuracy, but the gate on the 20-seed mean is marginal.

cruxes: How much of the accuracy gap on seeds 13–32 versus seeds 0–2 is true population mean versus selection and rebuild noise? This sets whether any further time cut can be kept.
Does the stem (group 1) need a gradient every step, or only some exposure at 32 px? This decides I084 and I085.
Does ReLU's saved backward traffic reach 3% of time, and how much accuracy does it cost?
